notes: No hard failures. Every surface traces to the site source. The menu (f0–16) matches site-menu.png and the menu.js LINKS order 01 Home … 09 Rules, with HOME in volt as the aria-current state on '/'. The categories page (f26–95) matches categories.html: eleven rows, groups, ages and fees all correct. The deadline line (f145–209) is the real register.html line 'Entries close 11:59 pm, Wednesday, November 18, 2026'. The mark (f130+) is the favicon.svg byte for byte, not recolored. The '11 / 11 categories' counter repeats the page's own 'Eleven categories' and invents nothing.

Overlays line up with the screenshot content. The press veil at f12–16 sits exactly between the separators above and below the 05 CATEGORIES row. The volt ticks and row tints at f55, f70, f85 and f95 cover exactly rows 1–2(+3), 1–6, 1–9(+10) and 1–11. The counter steps up as the marker reaches each row. The underline at f209 sits under both deadline lines and stops at '2026,'. The end hold is stable: frames 165–209 are pixel-identical (≤4/255 codec noise), about 1.5 s. The YDIF spikes at f16, f148 and f172 are codec keyframes with no visible change.

Reference fidelity is weak at the payoff. In tsenta, the pullback reveals a wall of results at a much smaller scale than the clicked card. Here the 'wall' (f130–209) is the same eleven rows at almost the same size as inside the phone at f95, regrouped into four blocks. The pullback is only about 1080 → 850 px of phone width, so the end frame reads as a restyled table, not a spatial reveal of scale. The scan phase (f42–93, about 1.7 s, 24% of runtime) is a locked camera with rows lighting one by one, which is not part of the reference's grammar.

Mobile readability: at 360 px wide (f145, f209), row labels render at about 9–10 px. The key closing claim, the deadline, is the weakest text in the frame: small grey JetBrains Mono (#8F97A8-ish) on near-black, tracked wide, about 9 px at phone scale. The '/ 11 CATEGORIES' label is similarly small.

Composition: f0–12 open with '06 REGISTER & FE' cut off at the right edge and the 01–09 numerals touching the left edge, which looks like an accidental crop, not a framed hero. During the lift (f112–122), rows overlap and clip each other ('player' cut to 'plaver' under Men's doubles and Women's doubles at f120). At f104 a dark gap opens mid-table, and the phone remnant drops off the bottom with its empty header at f120. The end frame (f165–209) is well filled, with consistent margins.

Motion causality: tap → page replace → scan → lift → regroup is a clear causal chain. But the f16–24 change is a double-exposure dissolve: menu caps, 'EVENT categories' and table rows ghost on top of each other at full scale (f18), and the cursor lingers over page text at f26. On the real site the press turns the link volt (menu.js: a:active{color:#D4FF3A}), and the menu fades out (.35s) before the page shows. The grey veil is a generic overlay, not the site's own press state.

Identity detail: the lockup 'SHUTTLE STORM ’26' (f130+) is set in plain, normal-width Archivo. The site's own brand text is wide-stretched, tracked uppercase (see the f26 header and the menu top bar).

Fixes: (1) Make the payoff a real spatial reveal. Shorten the scan to ≤1.0 s, then let the camera pull back well past the phone so the four group blocks (Juniors 2 / Youth 4 / Adults 4 / Masters 1) clearly outscale it, or give each group block its own label taken from the Group column. Don't re-show the same table at the same size. (2) In the end frame, set the row text to at least 36–40 px cap height at 1080 wide (use the full width and drop the 'per player' wrap if needed). Set the deadline line in bone #ECEEF2 at ≥40 px, or scale the authentic crop up, so it is the most readable line, not the least. (3) Reframe f0–12 so 'REGISTER & FEES' and the numerals are either fully inside the frame or clearly cropped tight around 05 CATEGORIES. (4) Replace the grey press veil with the site's real :active state (CATEGORIES text turns #D4FF3A). Replace the double-exposure dissolve with the menu's real fade-out to the categories page, or a clean cut. (5) Stagger the lift so rows never overlap or clip each other's text (f112–122), and hide the empty table gap and the phone remnant. (6) Set the lockup in the site's wide, tracked brand style.
